title: Logical Wooden Stairs
description: This project changes the crafting recipe of wooden stairs to only 3 planks instead of 6 planks
body:
Logical Wooden Stairs changes the crafting recipe of all of the wooden stairs, which include:

-Acacia Stairs

-Bamboo Stairs

-Birch Stairs

-Cherry Stairs

-Crimson Stairs

-Dark Oak Stairs

-Jungle Stairs

-Mangrove Stairs

-Oak Stairs

-Pale Oak Stairs

-Spruce Stairs

-Warped Stairs
